_about: Five-tab templates (CLAUDE.md 'Plans' step 5: why, evidence, benefits, unknown, check). For each plan the pipeline keeps every line whose 'when' conditions all hold ('always' always holds), fills the {placeholders}, and joins them; if none holds, the 'fallback' line is used, so no tab is empty. A line with 'repeat': 'sources' is written once per entry of sources[]. 'basis' points at the cited claim behind a line. Tips (CLAUDE.md 'Plans' step 6) are one string each. Every Nepali text was drafted by SI (Claude) on 2026-11-12 and needs native-speaker review before export; each node carries ne_review until a reviewer replaces it with their name and date. 'method_page' holds the method page's plain-word notes (owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13: explain the rain fix there in plain words), filled the same way.

why.en: This is what you grow now.
why.ne: यो तपाईंले अहिले लगाउने बाली हो।

why.en: We compare every other choice with it.
why.ne: हामी अरू हरेक विकल्पलाई यसैसँग दाँज्छौं।

why.en: This plan grows crops {cover_days_gain} more days.
why.ne: यो योजनामा {cover_days_gain} दिन बढी बाली हुन्छ।

why.en: Rains now start about {shift_days_abs} days earlier.
why.ne: वर्षा अहिले करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन चाँडै आउँछ।

why.ne: वर्षा अहिले करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन ढिलो आउँछ।

why.en: This plan plants to match the rains.
This plan is here to feed your soil.

why.ne: {legume_crop}ले अर्को बालीका लागि माटोमा मल थप्छ।

why.en: Bad years hurt it less than now.
why.ne: खराब वर्षमा यसलाई अहिलेभन्दा कम असर पर्छ।

why.en: It did well when we replayed your field.
why.ne: खेतका पुराना वर्ष दोहोर्‍याएर हेर्दा यो राम्रो देखियो।

evidence.en: We replayed the weather from {year_first} to {year_last}.
Harvest was {harvest} out of 100 on average.
With the town's long-term average rain: {harvest_dhm}.
evidence.basis: owner's decision 4b (2026-11-14): the range's dry edge is the rain scaled to DHM Bhaktapur's 1991-2020 normals (was: GPM as published, owner's decision 1)

benefits.en: Harvest: up to {gain_high} more, maybe none.

benefits.en: Less soil washes away in heavy rain.
benefits.ne: ठूलो पानी पर्दा कम माटो बग्छ।

benefits.en: {legume_crop} adds natural fertilizer to the soil.

benefits.en: No clear gain over what you do now.

rain_correction.en: NASA's rain maps are checked against rain gauges.

We scaled each month from {rain_fix_year} back down.

rain_correction.en: We tested this on years we kept aside.
